I am the Voice

Richard Crashaw (G.) (c. 1613–1649)

J
OHN
 
I.
 23
.
‘I 
AM
 the voice!’ thou sayest. Thou holy John,
If voice thou art, why was thy father dumb?
O silence strange! which as I muse upon,
I see thy voice from God, not man, did come.
